sources.title: COLORED PENCIL Magazine, 5 tips for Drawing Hair
sources.creator: Catie Sheeran
sources.rights: copyright magazine, study only; no photo or source paths copied
observations: Render the larger individual locks first and let dark troughs establish clump structure
Short colored-pencil marks follow hair direction, vary tone and pressure, and interrupt bright strand ribbons

sources.title: COLORED PENCIL Magazine, Dare to Draw Hair!
sources.creator: Silvia Maccaferri
observations: Preserve original dark strands before extending colored pencil highlights
Protect light reserves and direct all pencil marks in actual hair-growth direction

sources.title: How to Draw Portraits with Colored Pencils
sources.creator: Jasmina Susak
sources.rights: copyright artist process; technique study only; no artwork copied
observations: Low-pressure Dark Umber/Dark Brown shadows precede highlights
Sweep from both ends toward the reserved light with pressure lifted before the center

baseline.defect: Crown and sides read as a wig with coarse long parallel tan bands and uniform paper grain, not soft layered dark brown hair. Original 468-point ANAT1 face is untouched.

regions.strokes: 4 × 3 native short curved pigment families, occlusion trough
6 × 3 short pigment families plus dark trough/retained cream glint
4 × 3 rooted pigment groups per lock, narrow dark occlusion channels

five_axes.topology: Retain the 4 existing independently editable outer hair silhouettes, rooted behind the same ANAT1 face and collars; never detached stickers
five_axes.vector_flow: Three pressure passes of short Beziers follow local curved roots; not uniform broad diagonal stripes
five_axes.weight: Low-pressure umber/sepia undercoat with sparse chestnut/cream glints, no high-opacity white wig ribbons
five_axes.rhythm: Seeded stagger and clump-specific lengths; >1600 individual authored dry-pencil contacts with independent region names
five_axes.texture: Native CP-F1 fiber/paper tooth and timed layering; no bitmap, photo edit or noise substitute

negative_controls: uniform matte gradient hiding missing hair structure
